scientific_integrity: The result rests on exact grounded-Laplacian equations, complete finite enumerations and separate integer determinant calculations; no publication or independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted undirected connected simple graphs, two pinned opposite leaders, full-population quadratic opinion variance, and only follower-follower edge addition; lower bound exhaustive through five graphs and six-vertex trees only. Related technical literature not universally accessible.
title: Sharp graph and tree thresholds for edge-induced disagreement in two-leader harmonic opinions
